plan.line: an IR obstacle sensor (FC-51): says yes or no, is something in front of it, about 2 to 30 cm away (set with its small screw). Its output is LOW while something is in front. It can't measure the distance, and dark or shiny surfaces are seen less well.

code.pinLine: IR obstacle sensor {ref} on {gpio}: Pin({g}, Pin.IN). value() is 0 while something is in front of it (about 2-30 cm, set with its screw) and 1 when the way is clear. It only says yes or no: it can't measure how far.
